name: Starfield
description: Stars streaming continuously outward from the centre. Flow is one-directional and only occasionally eases backwards; brightness is deliberately steady rather than flashing on the beat.

speed.description: Forward flow rate. Kept modest — this is travel, not a strobe.

rollback.description: How far the flow eases backwards on its slow cycle. 0 never reverses; above ~0.5 it reverses for a noticeable stretch.

rollRate.description: How often a roll-back happens. 0.09 is roughly one every 70 seconds.

streak.description: Radial elongation. Small values keep them points; large values turn the field into warp-speed comets.
